item.text: IBAC reviewed its recommendations to Victorian public sector agencies to explain their scope and how agencies responded.
item.support: highlighting the volume and breadth of recommendations IBAC has made to public sector agencies

item.text: It analysed 260 recommendations issued between 2014 and 2025, excluding recommendations to Victoria Police.
item.support: IBAC analysed 260 recommendations made to the Victorian public sector

item.text: IBAC reported that agencies had fully implemented 84 per cent of recommendations after excluding those still in progress or not yet started.
item.support: 84 per cent of IBAC’s public sector recommendations, have been fully implemented by agencies
item.section: Key findings about IBAC’s recommendations to the public sector

item.text: It found that conflicts of interest, complaint handling, corruption reporting and procurement were the risks most commonly addressed.
item.support: The most common corruption risks targeted by IBAC’s public sector recommendations were conflicts of interest
item.section: Key findings about IBAC’s recommendations to the public sector

item.quote: IBAC assessed 168 recommendations as fully implemented, meaning IBAC is satisfied with the responses provided by agencies to demonstrate how the recommendations have been implemented.
The median time taken for agencies to fully implement IBAC’s recommendations was 13 months.
